About Us

Serving Maharashtra Since 1996

A government-certified, MSME-registered proprietary firm with 28+ years of trusted service to public and private institutions across the Mumbai Metropolitan Region.

Est. 1996

M/S. Vishal Super Services

Based in Kalyan (East), Thane — specializing in integrated facility management and human resource outsourcing for government and semi-government clients across Maharashtra.

Govt. e-Marketplace Seller

Vishal Super Services was founded with a mission to deliver high-quality facility management and manpower solutions to government institutions across Maharashtra. Over more than two decades, we have earned an unmatched reputation for reliability, statutory compliance, and service excellence.

Our firm is proprietorship-run by Mrs. Satyashila Ramesh Shejul and managed professionally by Mr. Ramesh Shejul, who personally oversees every work order, deployment, and quality check.

"We are not just a contractor — we are a long-term partner committed to keeping your operations running smoothly, safely, and efficiently."

We are registered on the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) portal, making us eligible for direct government procurement. Our NSIC registration validates our credibility for central and state government tenders.

All workforce is background-verified, uniformed, ID-card carrying, and trained before deployment — ensuring safety, accountability, and professionalism at every client location.
